1h.coverage_note: THE WINDOW LABEL IS THE CHARTER'S; THE DATA IS NOT. CME Ether futures began trading 2021-02-08, so the 2013-01-01..2022-12-31 in-sample window holds 690 days of bars out of 3651 - 19% of it. This theta_vol is a median over the 2021 top and the 2022 bear market and nothing before them, which is a narrower and more volatile sample than every other anchor in this system. It is pinned rather than recomputed because the in-sample window is CLOSED: ETH history accumulating after 2022-12-31 is holdout, and folding it in would move a boundary that certified strategies were already measured against.
1h.file_note: Pinned in-sample theta_vol anchors, per (SYMBOL, TIMEFRAME). This file WINS over the regime cache - see realtime/regime_daemon.py load_theta_anchors - because it is the deliberate act and the cache is only what happens to exist. An anchor is per TIMEFRAME: NQ's theta_vol is 7.90 at 15m and 11.33 at 30m, a 43% different boundary on the same tape. Symbols absent here resolve from the cache.
